name: Partial Incline Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press them up to full extension.
Lower only partway, about halfway down.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A shortened-range incline dumbbell press that focuses on the upper chest without going deep at the shoulders.
